 By  The Canadian Press 
 TORONTO - Immanuel Quickley and Collin Murray-Boyles are back in the Toronto Raptors’ lineup for tonight’s game against the Boston Celtics.
 Quickley missed two games with a tight right hamstring.
 Murray-Boyles missed Monday’s 118-102 loss to the Memphis Grizzlies with an undisclosed illness.
 All-stars Scottie Barnes and Kawhi Leonard are still unavailable for Toronto (5-5).
 ARTICLE CONTINUES BELOW 
 Barnes will miss his third game with a strained left groin.
 Leonard has missed nine games as he recovers from swelling in his left knee.
 This report by The Canadian Press was first published Nov. 11, 2026.
